==Summary==
:{{pov|[[Egwene al'Vere]]}}

[[Egwene al'Vere|Egwene]] is practicing in her rooms at the [[White Tower|Tower]]. [[Nynaeve]] and [[Min]] are there with her and they talk about how good looking [[Galad]] is. They talk about [[Else Grinwell|Else]] looking at Galad intently in the courtyard but Galad was only interested in where Egwene might be. [[Elayne]] comes in and says King [[Galldrian]] is dead so there will be a war of succession in [[Cairhien]]. Egwene has not dreamed of [[Rand]] for several months.{{ref| Because of the four month transit to Falme by Portal Stone.}} [[Anaiya Carel|Anaiya]] has been recording her dreams and comparing them to real events to test whether she is a dreamer; there is no conclusion as of yet. Nynaeve is in a foul mood after a visit to [[Sheriam]]'s study after she clouted another accepted. They discuss the danger of drawing too much of the [[One Power|Power]] and [[burning out]]. They ask Min what she sees. She says she sees danger around them and that it is a new viewing, different form what she has usually seen.

[[Liandrin]] comes in and says Nynaeve should not be associating with [[novices]] since she is Accepted. Min and Elayne are sent out of the room. She says Rand and the other boys are in great trouble from [[Shayol Ghul]]. She claims that [[Moiraine]] sent letters to the Tower inquiring about Nynaeve and Egwene. They need to go to [[Toman Head]] in order to help them. Nynaeve challenges Liandrin on what she has said and what she is not saying and why the two of them would be able to help. Liandrin tells them to meet her at the [[Ogier grove]], and tell no one because the [[Black Ajah]] are in the Tower.

Min and Elayne come in, saying they heard everything from Elayne’s room. Min says she’s coming with them to get away from all of the prying by the [[Amyrlin]] and [[Brown Ajah]] sisters. Elayne says she’s going too. Egwene and Nynaeve try to talk her out of it and finally ask Min to try also. But Min shakes her head and says that Elayne has to come too, because Min has read them again and now sees that Elayne is part of the danger. Nynaeve begins making plans for the trip while Egwene worries about Rand.
